title: Free coordinates lie within the available set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign to each coordinate in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ one of the statuses free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$, and let $A\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. Say that $\rho$ is free within $A$ if every coordinate assigned status free belongs to $A$.
